RFERP v1.3.0

== 中文 ==

一、新功能

- 侧栏左下角新增「设置」入口。点击后在右侧主内容区显示，不弹新窗口，方便对照当前业务页面查阅
  - 「使用指南」：随程序内置，断网也能读；顶部显示当前版本与内置最新版本，并可手动「查询最新更新」
  - 「常见问题」：按症状查阅，已从使用指南末尾独立出来
  - 「更新说明」：可点选查看每个历史版本的变更内容，当前收录 1.0.0 至 1.2.2 共 5 个版本
  - 发布脚本会在每次发版时自动累积更新说明，不必再手工维护

二、问题修复

- 修复：MySQL 的 .sql 导入此前只追加 INSERT、从不删除，恢复整份备份必然失败；现在 MySQL 与 SQLite 都是整库恢复（清空业务表后在同一事务内回灌），不再合并
  - 只恢复数据。备份中的建表与会话语句仍被忽略，不会改动现有表结构
  - users / schema_migrations / db_identity 会保留，其在备份中的记录被跳过
    —— 账号不参与回滚，否则恢复到只剩唯一账号之前的备份会导致无法登录
  - 恢复与清空都会先生成安全副本（pre_restore_ / pre_clear_），副本失败即中止；每类保留最新 5 份
  - 恢复界面有四道确认：备份文件校验、需手动输入的时间戳令牌、说明后果的确认框、执行中禁用按钮
- 修复：恢复结果现在区分「已回滚」「结果不确定」「已应用但收尾失败」，并各自给出下一步建议；SQLite 的安全副本清理按存储类型分别处理
- 修复：拒绝带库名限定的转储目标，避免恢复到错误的库
- 修复：本机 MySQL 未运行时改为通过服务控制管理器启动，权限不足时只把这一条操作提权；提权时显示的是「RFERP」而不是「net 命令」
  - 改用服务控制管理器 API 后，「拒绝访问。」不再因中文 Windows 的 GBK 控制台编码而显示为乱码
  - 已配置好的程序不再被退回首次配置向导，改为显示「数据库不可用」界面并给出重试 / 启动 MySQL / 退出
- 修复：在列表页（产品 / 零件 / BOM / 批次 / 用户）点选靠下的行时，列表会突然跳回顶部
- 修复：已撤销的批次不再计入出库统计

三、其他

- 文档：明确区分 SQLite 与 MySQL 的恢复语义（整库回退 vs 仅恢复数据）
- 文档：README 中明确许可证立场（保留所有权利）
- 已安装 1.2.2 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级，无需重新安装
- 数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Features

- A new "设置" (Settings) entry at the bottom of the sidebar. It replaces the main
  content area rather than opening a window, so you can read it beside the page
  you are checking
  - "使用指南" (Guide): ships inside the program and stays readable offline;
    shows the current and built-in latest version, with a manual
    "查询最新更新" (check for updates)
  - "常见问题" (FAQ): symptom-first lookup, split out of the end of the guide
  - "更新说明" (Changelog): per-version release notes you can pick from a list,
    currently covering the five releases from 1.0.0 to 1.2.2
  - The release script now accumulates the in-app changelog automatically

Fixes

- Restoring a MySQL .sql backup replayed only INSERT statements and never deleted
  anything, so restoring a full backup could not succeed. Restore is now a
  whole-database restore on both backends: the business tables are cleared and
  repopulated from the backup in a single transaction, and nothing is merged
  - Only data is restored. DDL and session statements in the dump are still
    ignored, so the live schema is never modified
  - users / schema_migrations / db_identity are preserved and their rows in the
    dump are skipped. Accounts are deliberately not rolled back: restoring a
    backup that predates your only account would leave a database you cannot log
    into
  - Restore and clear each take a safety copy first (pre_restore_ / pre_clear_)
    and abort if that copy fails; the five most recent of each kind are kept
  - Restoring is guarded by four gates: a verified backup file, a token you type
    in yourself, a confirmation that spells out the consequences, and disabled
    buttons while it runs
- Restore outcomes are now distinguished — rolled back, uncertain, and applied
  but failed to finalise — each with its own recommended next step. SQLite safety
  copies are now pruned per storage backend
- Dumps that qualify tables with a schema name are rejected instead of restoring
  into the wrong database
- When the local MySQL service is not running it is now started through the
  service control manager, elevating only that one operation if permissions
  require it. The UAC prompt now names "RFERP" rather than "net command"
  - Switching to the service control manager API also fixes messages such as
    "拒绝访问。" being shown as mojibake, because the console code page on a
    Chinese Windows is GBK
  - A configured install is no longer sent back into the first-run setup wizard.
    It gets a "数据库不可用" screen with retry / start MySQL / quit
- Selecting a row near the bottom of a list (products / parts / BOM / batches /
  users) no longer scrolls the list back to the top
- Revoked batches are no longer counted in outbound stock statistics

Other

- Docs: the different restore semantics of SQLite and MySQL are now stated
  separately
- Docs: the licensing position (all rights reserved) is now explicit in the README
- Note: the list fix works by the table no longer taking keyboard focus, so the
  arrow keys no longer move the selection between rows. Mouse selection is
  unchanged.
- Users already on 1.2.2 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.2

== 中文 ==

一、问题修复

- 修复：打开「操作记录」会导致程序直接退出（闪退）；现在可以正常打开与查看
- 修复：数据库升级前会先自动备份，且备份失败就不再继续升级
  · MySQL：升级前生成并校验一份 .sql 备份（保存到备份目录）
  · SQLite：升级前生成并校验一份 .db 快照
  · 备份失败时中止升级，避免出现「升级到一半」的库
  · 全新空库初始化不会产生多余备份

二、其他

- 已安装 1.2.1 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级，无需重新安装
- 数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Fixes

- Opening the operation log no longer crashes the app; the page opens normally
- A database upgrade now takes a verified pre-upgrade backup first, and does not
  proceed if that backup fails
  - MySQL: a .sql dump is written and verified before the upgrade
  - SQLite: a .db snapshot is created and verified before the upgrade
  - If the backup fails the upgrade is aborted, so a database can no longer be
    left half-upgraded
  - A fresh empty database is still initialised without an extra backup

Other

- Users already on 1.2.1 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.1

== 中文 ==

一、问题修复

- 修复：在列表页（产品 / 零件 / BOM / 批次 / 用户）点选靠下的行时，列表会突然跳回顶部；
  现在点选不再改变滚动位置
  （原因：清选中态时用到了一个会连带滚动的底层调用，已改为只清选中、不滚动）

二、其他

- 已安装 1.2.0 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级到本版本，无需重新安装
- 本版本不含新功能；数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Fixes

- Selecting a row near the bottom of a list (products / parts / BOM / batches / users)
  no longer scrolls the list back to the top; the scroll position is now preserved
  (the selection was being cleared with a lower-level call that also scrolled, and it
  now clears without scrolling)

Other

- Users already on 1.2.0 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No new features; no manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.0

== 中文 ==

一、重点更新

1. 新增本地 SQLite 存储（单机零安装）
- 首次运行向导新增「存储方式」选择：MySQL（多人/高级）或 SQLite（单机零安装）
- SQLite 模式下整个数据库就是数据目录下的一个文件 rferp.db，完全不需要安装 MySQL
- 旧配置（没有 storage 字段）继续使用 MySQL，程序不会静默切换
- 备份/恢复与存储类型绑定：MySQL 用 .sql（导入时仅追加 INSERT，不覆盖已有数据），
  SQLite 用整库 .db 快照（整库回退，完成后自动重启应用）
- 两种备份不可混用，跨类型恢复会被明确拒绝并给出提示

2. 新增产品 / 零件可搜索选择器
- BOM 页与产品 / 零件列表页新增「输入即筛选」下拉，按编码 / 名称 / 规格匹配
- BOM 页的「产品 → 零件 → 用量」级联与查询框双向同步，用哪边选都得到一致结果
- 产品 / 零件列表支持本地即时筛选，不再重新查询数据库

3. 表格列宽自适应
- 产品、BOM、批次、用户、看板等表格按内容自动调整列宽，超长内容以省略号截断，
  不再出现文字被挤压或列宽与内容不匹配

二、功能改进

- 库存与审计写入改为同一事务：批次状态流转与库存扣减、审计日志与业务写入，
  不再可能只成功一半
- 数量校验更严格：拒绝负数 / 零等非法值，金额统一按 2 位小数量化
- CSV 导出失败会明确报错（不再静默），并在失败时清理临时文件
- 登录与首次创建管理员更稳健：用户数查询异常时正常显示登录窗（不再误入「创建管理员」）；
  遇到「已初始化」自动切换到登录窗

三、问题修复

- 批次状态变更与库存扣减改为原子操作（此前中途失败可能造成库存与状态不一致）
- 审计日志与业务写入改为原子操作
- 拒绝非法的库存数量（负数 / 零）
- 库存审计数值统一量化，避免浮点小数残留
- CSV 导出错误会向上抛出，失败时删除临时文件
- 会话级数据库设置（外键 / 唯一性检查）固定在同一连接，不再跨连接串用

四、其他

- SQLite 恢复前会自动把当前数据库另存为 rferp.db.before-restore-<时间戳>，
  并清理陈旧的 WAL/SHM 文件
- 存储方式仅在「首次运行向导」中选择；从 1.1.0 升级的已有安装继续使用 MySQL
- 数据库结构升级到 v13（新增内部标识表，用于数据库身份校验）；程序自动迁移，无需手工操作
- 构建工具链：Go 1.22 → Go 1.26（发布使用 go1.26.5）；
  SQLite 采用纯 Go 驱动（modernc.org/sqlite，无 CGO，无需额外运行库）
- 工程与流程：新增 PR 校验工作流（Windows / Go verify）、PR 模板、
  按标签分组的自动发布说明、CONTRIBUTING.md；主分支规则集归档到 docs/rulesets/
- 内部重构：抽出用例接口与仓储接口，为后续扩展铺路；补充了大量单元与集成测试

== English ==

Highlights

1. Local SQLite storage (single machine, zero install)
- The first-run wizard now offers a storage choice: MySQL (multi-user / advanced)
  or SQLite (single machine, zero install)
- With SQLite the whole database is one file, rferp.db in your data directory,
  and MySQL is not needed at all
- Existing configs (no "storage" key) keep using MySQL; nothing switches silently
- Backup and restore follow the storage: MySQL uses .sql (importing only appends
  INSERTs and never overwrites existing data), SQLite uses whole-file .db snapshots
  (full rollback, then the app restarts automatically)
- The two kinds are not interchangeable; a cross-kind restore is refused with a
  clear message

2. Searchable product / part picker
- BOM and product / part list pages gained a type-to-filter dropdown matching
  code, name and spec
- On the BOM page the product -> part -> usage cascade and the search box stay in
  sync both ways, so either way of choosing gives the same result
- Product and part lists can be filtered instantly without re-querying the database

3. Tables fit their content
- Product, BOM, batch, user and dashboard tables size their columns to the content
  and truncate anything too long with an ellipsis, so text is no longer squeezed
  and column widths match what they hold

Improvements

- Inventory and audit writes now share one transaction: a batch status change plus
  its stock deduction, and an audit entry plus its business write, can no longer
  half-commit
- Quantity validation is stricter: negative or zero values are rejected, and amounts
  are consistently rounded to two decimals
- CSV export failures are reported instead of being swallowed, and temporary files
  are cleaned up
- Login and first-run admin creation are more robust: a failed user-count query shows
  the login window instead of the "create admin" window, and an already-initialized
  server switches to login automatically

Fixes

- Batch status changes and stock deductions are now atomic (a failure in between
  could leave stock and status out of step)
- Audit entries and their business writes are now atomic
- Invalid inventory quantities (negative / zero) are rejected
- Stock audit values are quantized, avoiding floating-point leftovers in the log
- CSV export errors are propagated, and the temp file is removed on failure
- Session-level database settings (foreign-key / unique checks) stay on one connection
  instead of leaking across the pool

Other

- A SQLite restore first keeps your current database as rferp.db.before-restore-<timestamp>
  and clears stale WAL/SHM files
- The storage choice is offered only by the first-run wizard; installations upgraded
  from 1.1.0 keep using MySQL
- Schema upgraded to v13 (an internal identity table used for database identity checks);
  the app migrates automatically, no manual step needed
- Toolchain: Go 1.22 -> Go 1.26 (releases built with go1.26.5); SQLite uses a pure-Go
  driver (modernc.org/sqlite, no CGO, no extra runtime)
- Engineering: PR verification workflow (Windows / Go verify), PR template, automatic
  release notes grouped by label, CONTRIBUTING.md, branch rulesets archived under
  docs/rulesets/
- Internal refactor: use-case and repository interfaces extracted to prepare for future
  extensions; substantially more unit and integration tests

RFERP v1.1.0

一、重点更新

1. 新增用户账号与权限系统
- 支持登录、首次运行创建管理员、记住登录（下次自动进入）
- 四种角色：管理员 / 仓管 / 生产 / 只读
- 按角色控制功能可见性：无权限的功能直接不显示
- 管理员可管理用户：新增 / 编辑 / 重置密码 / 删除
- 所有操作自动记录真实操作人（不再固定为 admin）
- 账号数据存于数据库，多机共享

2. 备份/导出目录可自选
- 默认目录改为 %USERPROFILE%\RFERP
- 可在「备份导出」页应用内修改，相关路径提示随之更新

二、功能改进

3. 操作记录结构化展示
- 拆分为：时间 / 类型 / 操作 / 对象 / 变更明细 / 操作人
- 支持点击查看详情（变更前后 + 原始数据）
- 新增「批次追溯」筛选

三、问题修复
- 修复只读用户仍可修改 BOM 的越权问题
- 修复可停用/删除最后一个管理员导致无人可管理的问题
- 修复任务栏不显示应用图标（exe 图标为非正方形单尺寸）
- 修复操作记录表名未汉化（batch_trace → 批次追溯）
- 修复操作记录列宽超出默认窗口
- 修复数据库口令为空时无法保存配置

四、其他
- 构建脚本改为路径无关（任意目录可执行），统一工具探测
- README 补充构建环境要求（64 位 mingw-w64 GCC，已验证 TDM-GCC）

RFERP-仁风仓库管理系统 v1.0.0

首个正式版本。

功能
- 产品 / 零件 / BOM 管理
- 生产批次与投料追溯
- 库存出入库与预警
- 操作审计日志
- 数据备份与导出（CSV / SQL）

安装与更新
- 首次运行向导：自动检测本机 MySQL，一键建库建表并创建专用账号
- 数据库口令使用 Windows DPAPI 加密保存
- 启动自动检查更新（Ed25519 签名校验）
- 安装包支持中文界面，可自选安装路径
